trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Use the 54 non-platinum trophies as your checklist. Check the platinum separately when it appears in your PlayStation list.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Use Gone Fishing as your first named checkpoint. Check for the award after the mission ends. Cal's fishing challenge has its own trophy.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Check this off at the end of Chapter 1. Use the chapter transition as your cue to compare the in-game award with your tracker.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Use the Chapter 2 clear as your next story checkpoint. Keep named mission awards on their own checklist so you can spot any gaps.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: At the Chapter 3 transition, check your PlayStation list for the chapter award. The title is a label for the chapter clear, so use the chapter number to track it.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Check for this award when Chapter 4 ends. Keep the finale on your list as a separate story milestone with its own gold trophy.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: After clearing the story finale, verify the gold award and switch to the unearned list for cleanup. Check the separate 100% completion trophy as well.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Match the mission title Breakfast Run as it comes up in the story and verify the award when it ends. The list gives no chapter placement for it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Track The Cartel Heist under story missions. Keep its award separate from Maximum Withdrawal, which tracks vault robberies with escapes.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Check your trophy list when Child's Play ends. The description supplies the mission title as the way to identify the objective.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Look for Headliners in your mission progress. Mark the trophy when the mission clears and the award appears on PlayStation.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Use VCIA Takedown as the mission checkpoint. Track the separate VCIA departure objective independently, since it describes a different condition.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Use the full Operation Savage Glory mission title to identify this story award. Verify it after the mission clear before moving to your next checkpoint.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Check the game's completion percentage. Use it alongside this trophy tracker during cleanup, since the list gives no breakdown of what feeds that percentage.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Chip away at stunt completions while exploring. Use credited completions for your tally and check your starting count before each cleanup session.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Make a list of activity types as you encounter them and try each one. Prioritize your first attempt at a new type over another run of a favorite.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Make a medal checklist for the 42 range challenges. Clear the board once, then revisit every entry below gold. The last upgrade matters as much as your first gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Keep one winning result per Top Fun location. When cleaning up the 14-location set, look for gaps by venue before replaying a race you've already won.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Record the race name after each win and keep only unique entries. Use that list to pick your next race until it contains 20 wins on different events.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take Cal's challenge when it is available and verify the winning result. The list specifies the opponent and leaves availability and rematches open.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Choose one arcade game and play through its ending. Check the award on returning to regular play before spending time on another cabinet.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: When Andy's missions become available, follow the chain to its last assignment. Use the trophy unlock to confirm that you've reached the end of the strand.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Keep Kenton's thread open in your checklist until the endpoint. The description identifies the contact but offers no mission title or cutoff.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Follow up whenever Billy offers another assignment. Verify the trophy after the final one and leave the chain unmarked while any assignment is outstanding.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Keep an eight-line list of stranger contacts and tick each line after its whole chain finishes. Use the contact name to avoid counting several missions as several strands.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Prioritize Randy's follow-up missions when available. The award is your confirmation of the endpoint because the official entry identifies it only by the contact.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Follow Tyrone's assignments through their conclusion. Check your trophy list after each clear so you can identify which assignment closed the strand.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Log a spot after meditating there. Track the 18 spots by distinct location and use your notes to avoid revisiting completed stops during cleanup.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Use Bret's objective to identify the animal, and verify the award after completing that hunt. The trophy text leaves the species and location unspecified.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Group your card checklist by set as soon as you start collecting. When a set is nearly full, focus your search on its missing cards. Progress is measured in three finished sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Record each new location after doing the WAiNK It interaction. Track 100 distinct stops and use your notes to avoid duplicating a location during cleanup.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Use the game's credited challenge completions to find your remaining target. Recheck the total after batches and switch tasks when you have an easier unfinished challenge available.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: In game, confirm your partner is with you when the wanted display reaches four stars. Keep the same attempt going until the wanted display clears, then verify the award.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Treat the three shops as a single in-game attempt with your partner. Watch the wanted indicator between stops and restart your tally if it clears before the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Fold vehicle discoveries into exploration and note which ones the game credits. During cleanup, prioritize unfamiliar vehicles and verify how the discovery counter responds.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Use an in-game encounter with five eligible enemies. Track all five takedowns inside one activation; begin a fresh attempt if Combat Focus ends early.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Use VCIA as the location clue. Check the trophy after an in-game departure there; the wording leaves the method and eligible vehicle open.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Keep this open for later verification. Rhinos are the clue in the list; use the trophy notification to confirm a trigger before treating a Rhino encounter as complete.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Treat detection as the failure condition for the in-game attempt. If the game registers detection, use a fresh attempt to verify the stealth award.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Record each eligible in-game vault run after the escape. Compare your trophy progress after each run; the list leaves repeat eligibility unspecified.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Check for the award at the end of the in-game escape. Track the armored truck objective separately from bank vaults since the target type differs.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Keep a record of newly credited areas on your travels. Finish by checking gaps in your 52-area tally, rather than using mileage as a measure of coverage.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Track these in-game operations by gang affiliation. For cleanup, look for a missing affiliation in your nine-gang tally before attempting another operation.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Use Ocean Beach as the named search area. Look for the cocktail interaction there and verify the award afterward. The list leaves the venue and drink unspecified.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Start this in-game attempt from inside a vehicle showroom. Use the trophy notification to verify an exit, since the list leaves the dealership and vehicle unspecified.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Use Kolt & Associates as your destination clue and try the bowling interaction there. The list leaves the score and frame requirements open, so check for the award after play.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Keep this on your verification list during partner activities. The partnership is the only concrete clue given, so use the actual unlock to identify the trigger.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Watch the 500-count target as you make choices in play. Check for increments after sessions and use the counter to identify which decisions the game credits.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: When the game offers a retry, check whether a successful second attempt awards this trophy. Treat that as a reading of the clue until an unlock confirms it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Keep this as an open verification item. The description names no action or place. If it triggers during play, note the event and confirm the award before closing it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Use the in-game melee drive-by action and check for the award after a knockdown. Track this separately from the named bowling alley trophy.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Use the in-game contacts tied to Marked Bills and track the proceeds they credit. Compare that running total to $250,000; your general cash balance tracks more than this objective.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Fold this into normal in-game shop visits and check how spending accumulates toward $100,000. Treat property purchases as a separate checklist for Little Boxes.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Keep a property checklist of the eight garages. Verify ownership after each purchase and use the list to identify your last outstanding garage.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Track vehicles after the Scooter Bros app accepts their registration. Use its credited list to work toward ten and keep discoveries on the separate vehicle trophy.
